discarded_claims.claim: The rider's presence at the pin is equally unestablished. With no trace at all there is no rider_track, and POL-NS-04(c) itself provides that where rider_track is absent limb (c) is UNDECIDABLE and neutral, the artifact being impaired, and that the tribunal must say the test could not be run rather than inferring the rider was elsewhere — or, by the same logic, that she was there. Her account of standing at the bay from 5.45 is corroborated by nothing in this bundle.
discarded_claims.reason: Step 1(c): the claim rests on the impaired artifact EV-GPS-00213 (weight_multiplier 0.0) but does not name the issue code that fired (MISSING_ARTIFACT). Saying 'no trace at all / the artifact being impaired' discloses the fact of impairment but not the issue code, as POL-GEN-02(1) requires.

discarded_claims.claim: Under POL-NS-02 the arrival question is arithmetic rather than impressionistic: where the gps_trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes preceding the cancellation, the driver never arrived, limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. EV-GPS-00213 contains no fix at all — it is absent and carries weight 0.0 — so it cannot contain a qualifying in-radius fix, and the $6.00 cancellation-fee line itemised on EV-FARE-00213 must be refunded in full to the rider.
discarded_claims.reason: Step 1(c): the claim rests on the impaired artifact EV-GPS-00213 (weight_multiplier 0.0) but names only its weight ('absent and carries weight 0.0'), not the issue code that fired (MISSING_ARTIFACT), as POL-GEN-02(1) requires.

discarded_claims.claim: The facts that decide this case — arrival, dwell and rider presence — are carried solely by EV-GPS-00213 and EV-CHAT-00213, each at weight 0.0. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the Judge's confidence may not exceed the weight of the artifacts that carry the deciding fact, so it is capped at 0.0, far below the 0.70 platform floor that POL-NS-09(a) enforces. Escalation — which holds the fee rather than collecting a sum no admissible evidence supports — is the correct disposition.
discarded_claims.reason: Step 1(c): the claim rests on the impaired artifacts EV-GPS-00213 and EV-CHAT-00213 (weight_multiplier 0.0 each) but states only their weights ('each at weight 0.0') and not the issue code that fired (MISSING_ARTIFACT), as POL-GEN-02(1) requires.

discarded_claims.claim: One open question the reviewer should settle, and it is a driver-favourable one: the pickup carries TWO registered pickup points at a TRANSPORT_HUB interchange (trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 2), and no admissible chat record shows the rider naming a specific entrance, block or bay. On those facts POL-NS-03(ii), not POL-NS-03(i), is the limb that would apply if the parties simply held different faces of the same interchange — the mislocation would be attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to the driver, and the driver would receive the platform-funded goodwill payment of 50 percent of the cancellation fee, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. I do not ask the tribunal to find the driver was outside the arrival radius — no trace exists to show it either way — only that the reviewer resolve the pin question on the escalated record.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this case goes to a human reviewer, and the $6.00 cancellation fee is held — not collected from the rider and not refunded — until that review is finished. This is not a win for either side; it is a decision that the record as it stands cannot settle the question.

WHAT THE CASE TURNS ON. A no-show fee is chargeable only if the driver actually reached the pickup point and held position there for at least five minutes, and both questions are answered from the GPS trace. There is no GPS trace for this trip at all — EV-GPS-00213 is missing (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) — and the in-app chat export is missing too (EV-CHAT-00213, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), even though the trip record counts three messages. The two things that would decide the case are the two things we do not have.

RIDER. I cannot order the full refund you asked for. An absent trace is not a trace that shows the driver never arrived; it is impaired evidence, and the policy is explicit that a missing or too-sparse trace is not proof of absence (POL-NS-02, POL-NS-08). So the automatic refund that applies when the GPS shows the driver never came does not fire here. I accept that the trip record shows no boarding and records the driver ending the trip with reason code RIDER_UNREACHABLE — that is one of the four conditions for charging the fee — but the two conditions about his actual position and waiting time cannot be confirmed, so the fee cannot be confirmed either. Your three messages and your presence at the bay appear only as counts; because the export is missing they cannot be read, and that retention failure is the platform's, not yours. It is also why the charge is not simply being kept.

DRIVER. I cannot confirm your fee or pay you compensation. The arrival stamp and the 6.6 minutes to cancellation are your own arrival tap and the platform's arithmetic from it; the rule measures waiting time from GPS fixes inside the geofence, and there are none. Your statement that you were at the bay from about 5.47 to 5.53 and answered every message is an account, not a measurement, and it cannot supply the missing measurement. The anti-farming check does not trip (3 no-show terminations against 107 completed trips is below both thresholds), so nothing is withheld from you on that ground — but there is nothing to pay you on either. The same missing trace means the wrong-entrance / pin-ambiguity question at a hub with two pickup points cannot be assessed, and the waiting-period shortfall clause (POL-NS-06) cannot be run without a dwell measurement and without a traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00213-01 is also missing, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT).

THE MONEY IS CORRECT AS ITEMISED. $6.00 is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee ($6.00) and the RYDE_X tier fee ($4.00), so the ledger reconciles and there is no billing-integrity defect.

WHY A HUMAN MUST DECIDE. POL-NS-09(c) requires escalation where the same rider and driver have two or more no-show disputes in the trailing 90 days. Both profiles record 2, and your own words, rider, are that this is the same driver as the last two times. Independently, the evidence that would decide the fee is impaired: the deciding fact (whether the driver was inside the geofence for the required dwell) is carried solely by the absent trace, so under POL-GEN-02(2) my confidence is capped at 0.0 — the minimum weight among the artifacts carrying that fact — far below the 0.70 floor. The case therefore cannot be closed here.

OPEN QUESTIONS FOR THE REVIEWER (information only, not a referral). Can the driver-device trace and the message export be recovered at all? If not, does the $6.00 stand or is it refunded on the accounts on file? And do the two prior disputes between this pair indicate a pattern? No clause produces a formal referral on these facts: the false-arrival referral in POL-NS-05(ii) needs a trace showing the driver was not at the pickup, and there is no trace; the anti-farming referral in POL-NS-07 needs that check to trip, and it does not.
